result.rationale: Several days of positional vertigo (spinning with head movement/rolling over that settles) is most consistent with benign positional vertigo, and the patient reports no chest pain, weakness, or headache. A physician should assess to confirm the pattern, screen for other red flags (hearing change, imbalance, visual or speech changes), and advise on treatment or exam; messaging can begin this. Reported findings do not support same-day emergency escalation.
